thread_title: S. moorei x flava rugelii Eastern AL
breadcrumb: S. moorei x flava rugelii Eastern AL

posts.body_html:
Here's an interesting cross: it's a red throated moorei crossed with a "hybridy" looking flava var. rugelii, both parents originally from eastern Alabama. The flava rugelii looks like a slightly red variant that came from back crossing moorei with flava rugelii, but no amount of white shows up on the trap.

This really makes me think: Is this how Adrian Slack came about? Photos taken 5/1/17:







Ellie Photobombing! You can't tell, but she has chocolate all over her face:



This trap just opened so it has some coloring up to do. More pics to come in the future.
